scene_description: A wrapped lemon loaf rests on the lid of a tan food container on a gray table. The blue chip bag lies separately behind the container.

targets.name: food container
targets.description: Tan square container with a clear lid in front of the blue bag, supporting the lemon loaf package.
nearby_obstacles: Lemon loaf resting on the lid
targets.clearance_notes: Front and side faces are exposed; the loaf covers and loads part of the lid. The target is set back from the front accessible edge; bringing it forward could reduce the approach distance even though some surfaces are exposed.

candidate_improvements.description: Lift the lemon loaf package off the container and place it roughly 20 cm to the right on clear tabletop.
After removing the lemon loaf, move the food container approximately 15 cm toward the front edge of the table, into a clear position while keeping the entire object supported.

targets.other_notes: Front means the foreground edge in images/01.jpg.

targets.name: blue chip bag
targets.description: Blue snack bag lying directly on the table behind the food container and loaf.
nearby_obstacles: Food container in front of the bag
targets.clearance_notes: Top and sides are exposed; the food container restricts a low approach from the front. It is also farther from the front table edge than the container; a forward-and-left placement can address both setback and the blocked frontal approach.

candidate_improvements.description: Lift the blue bag out from behind the container and place it roughly 20 cm diagonally forward and left on clear tabletop, nearer the accessible front edge. Keep it fully supported.

targets.other_notes: Front-approach limitation only; access from above or another side may already be sufficient. Front refers to the foreground table edge in images/01.jpg.

targets.name: lemon loaf
targets.description: Yellow lemon loaf in clear wrapping with a black label, lying on the food container lid with no bag on top.
targets.clearance_notes: Top and wrapper edges are exposed. The container supports it but does not cover it. The target is set back from the front accessible edge; bringing it forward could reduce the approach distance even though some surfaces are exposed.

candidate_improvements.description: Lift the loaf from the container and move the lemon loaf approximately 15 cm toward the front edge of the table, into a clear position while keeping the entire object supported.

targets.other_notes: The top package is unobstructed, but moving it nearer the front edge could improve approach access. Front means the foreground edge in images/01.jpg.

source: Staged permutation of S0020 and S0022, using the same objects in a different arrangement.
